title: Free energy acts as a Lyapunov function

statements.text: Because living systems return to a set of attracting states, their dynamics admit a Lyapunov function, and that function is surprisal, bounded by free energy. A system descending it can be described as performing inference without any added inferential machinery.

sources.quote: Mathematically, this implies the existence of a Lyapunov function that turns out to be model evidence (i.e., self-evidence) in Bayesian statistics or surprise (i.e., self-information) in information theory.
variational free energy is a Lyapunov function for neuronal dynamics, which therefore conform to Hamilton’s principle of least action.
